launchpad.title: Launchpad
launchpad.subtitle: Your fastest way to everything — and small Claude actions that keep an eye on it for you.

empty.title: No bookmarks yet
empty.body: Add the boards, groups and dashboards you open every day. Attach an action to any of them and Claude will check it on a schedule and tell you when something needs you.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group bookmarks (e.g. all Google Groups together). Deleting a category keeps its bookmarks — they become uncategorized.

form.description: A link you want one click away. The site's icon is fetched automatically.

notes.label: Notes
notes.placeholder: Optional — also used as context for the bookmark's action

logo.label: Logo
logo.uploaded_note: Using an uploaded image — pick another option to replace it.

delete.title: Delete bookmark?
delete.description: {{name}} will be removed from your Launchpad.
delete.description_with_action: {{name}} will be removed, together with its action and run history.

view.logo_too_big: Logos can be at most 256 KB.

notify_on.new_items: Only when something new shows up

action.toast_queued: Run queued — the host runner will pick it up
action.runner_offline: Actions run through your own Claude CLI and its MCP connectors. Start scripts/host-runner.sh — runs wait in the queue until it's up.

prompt.label: What should Claude check?
prompt.description: Describe the check in plain words. Claude reports back what needs you; you'll be notified based on the rule below.
prompt.placeholder: Search Jira project DATA for open tickets asking for BigQuery access that are not assigned to anyone yet. For each, tell me who needs access, to which dataset, and the ticket link.

servers.label: MCP servers it may use
servers.description: Only these servers' tools are available to the action.
servers.none_probed: No MCP servers known yet — refresh them on Home (needs the host runner).
servers.unhealthy: Not connected right now: {{names}} — runs will report the failure.

custom_cadence.label: Custom schedule
custom_cadence.description: cron:<expr> in your timezone, or every:<N>m / every:<N>h

writes.label: Allow changes (write tools)
writes.read_only: Read-only: write-type tools are blocked for this action.
writes.blocked_one: Read-only: {{count}} write tool is blocked for this action.
writes.blocked_other: Read-only: {{count}} write tools are blocked for this action.
writes.warning: This action may create, edit or delete things through its MCP servers, unattended. Only enable this for instructions you trust to run on their own.

runs.empty: No runs yet. Run the action, or wait for its schedule.
